entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: Manipulative planeswalker of unknown origin from the Shard of Twelve Worlds, slain by an astral dragon.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: Elder Dragon turned into a dragon whelp by Faralyn.

entities.name: Rhuell
entities.description: Dragon recruited by Faralyn who died at the Summit of the Null Moon.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Spellsquire of Faralyn who died at the Summit of the Null Moon.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Planeswalker who escaped the Shard with Faralyn.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Planeswalker who escaped the Shard with Faralyn.

entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: Summoned the astral dragon that slew Faralyn.

entities.name: Summit of the Null Moon
entities.description: Gathering organized by Faralyn hoping to provoke a planeswalker's death.

entities.name: War for Shandalar
entities.description: War begun when Faralyn escaped the Shard.

entities.name: Shard of Twelve Worlds
entities.description: Shard in which Faralyn, Rhuell and Ravidel were trapped.

events.summary: Faralyn turns the Elder Dragon Vaevictis Asmadi into a dragon whelp.
events.quote: Faralyn once turned the Elder Dragon Vaevictis Asmadi into a dragon whelp

events.summary: Faralyn takes Ravidel as his spellsquire.
events.quote: Faralyn took Ravidel as his spellsquire

events.summary: Faralyn organizes the Summit of the Null Moon, but Rhuell and Ravidel die instead, giving him energy to escape the Shard.
events.quote: Instead of planeswalkers, Rhuell and Ravidel died

events.summary: Faralyn is slain by an astral dragon summoned by Kenan Sahrmal.
events.quote: he was quickly slain by an astral dragon summoned by Kenan Sahrmal
